title: Grateful Dead Live at O'Keefe Center on 1967-08-04
lineage: CDR > EAC(secure) > Cool Edit(remove pops) > CDWav (retrack) > mkwact(seekable)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an early‑era jam featuring a stellar New Potato Caboose and a soaring Viola Lee Blues.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crisp, awesomely recorded sound (though some note the tape runs slightly fast). Musically the show offers two long pieces – a brilliant New Potato Caboose and an intense 20‑minute Viola Lee Blues that showcases Jerry’s developing improvisational voice, Phil’s solid bass, and Bob’s strong vocals.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars, highlighting both an excellent soundboard source and a strong early‑Dead performance with only minor inconsistencies.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is clear and intense; reviewers call it "awesomely recorded". One note mentions the tape runs fast, but no major drop‑outs or muffiness are reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only two tracks, each extended into a deep jam; the set feels like an early snapshot of the Dead evolving into their later jamming machine.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Flashes of brilliance and zone‑playing with Phil and Pigpen, though occasional moments where he "gets stuck" are noted.
band_member_comments.Phil: Delivers a great performance on bass throughout the jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides a nice vocal on New Potato Caboose.
